mentions.name: Agent engineer master
mentions.description: Agent engineer master is a skill builder that generates custom, production-grade skills for AI agents. The stated goal is to grow it into a system that non-engineers can use to build and deploy agents with just prompting.
mentions.audience: Goal is non-engineers who can build and deploy agents with just prompting; currently used to generate agent skills.
mentions.source_excerpt: Agent engineer master. Currently it's a skill builder to generate custom production grade skills for agents but my goal is to build it into a system that non engineers can use to build and deploy agents with just prompting. https://agentengineermaster.com/
